evals.name: Missing Routing Repair
evals.prompt: AGENTS.md exists and specs/architecture.md plus specs/commands.md exist, but AGENTS.md does not route into them. Reconcile the guidance surface.
evals.expected_output: Guidance map, must-fix finding, and a minimal routing repair proposal.
expectations: Discovers the real guidance surface before proposing edits
Classifies the routing gap as must-fix

evals.name: Coherent Alternative Router
evals.prompt: AGENTS.md points to WORKSPACE.md, and WORKSPACE.md cleanly routes into the right subtree docs. Review whether the repo should be normalized to a default specs layout.
evals.expected_output: Leave-alone or should-improve result that preserves the coherent router stack.
expectations: Avoids flattening the structure just to match a preferred style

evals.name: Minimal Bootstrap
evals.prompt: The repo has several specs files but no usable AGENTS.md routing block. Bootstrap the minimum missing structure.
evals.expected_output: A minimal AGENTS routing proposal instead of a broad rewrite.
expectations: Adds only the minimum entrypoint routing needed
Uses existing topic docs instead of inventing extra layers

evals.name: Lifecycle Gap Boundary
evals.prompt: Our agent forgets everything between sessions. We need progress.md, session-handoff.md, and init.sh. Reconcile the Codex docs to solve it.
evals.expected_output: Explicit out-of-scope callout that the real gap is state or lifecycle scaffolding, not guidance routing.
expectations: Does not over-repair the guidance surface
Names the missing lifecycle or state layer explicitly
Keeps guidance repair separate from harness scaffolding
Avoids pretending the docs alone solve the problem
